Python with class and functions, verify symbol count

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const tree_sitter_language_pack = @import("tree_sitter_language_pack");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try tree_sitter_language_pack.process("MY_CONST = 42\ndef helper(): pass\nclass Widget: pass\n", "{\"language\":\"python\",\"symbols\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
